subject.title: Android: add adaptive app navigation sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this app-wide Material3 navigation-suite redesign now, including the permanent-drawer presentation on expanded Android windows, rather than limit the work to a narrower responsiveness or accessibility repair?
rationale: The patch changes the product’s primary Android navigation hierarchy and interaction model across form factors; source-level correctness cannot determine whether this is the intended long-term UX direction.

options.title: Sponsor the adaptive navigation redesign
options.body: Accept the Material3 navigation-suite direction once direct current-head layout evidence confirms the existing workflows remain reachable across the supported window classes.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep the existing navigation model and request a smaller fix for the specific reachability or accessibility failures that maintainers want to address first.

options.title: Defer the redesign
options.body: Pause this PR until Android product ownership confirms the intended multi-window navigation roadmap.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the adaptive navigation redesign
recommendation.body: Accept the Material3 navigation-suite direction once direct current-head layout evidence confirms the existing workflows remain reachable across the supported window classes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available record identifies the contributor as the only concrete person connected to this proposed Android navigation implementation; repository ownership for these paths is otherwise unassigned in the supplied evidence.
